key.name: show-text
key.description: If disabled, only the icon is shown in the panel, without the numeric screen time value.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh the indicator, in seconds.

key.name: day-start-hour
key.description: Local-time hour (0–23) at which "today" starts. 0 is midnight (matches the Wellbeing statistics in Settings), 3 is when gnome-shell resets its daily limit.
